visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Shift Instead of Swapping
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each element is moved into place with repeated three-line swaps. Hold the element in a variable, shift the larger ones right, and write it once. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A swap writes two elements, while a shift writes one. Holding the element in key and writing it once at the end saves about two thirds of the memory writes.
